packageRules.description: Pin @types/node to the 24 series. In @types/node 26, worker_threads.TransferListItem no longer exists, so the thread-stream types that reference it cannot be built without skipLibCheck. The runtime (Dockerfile / .node-version) is already Node.js 26, so only the thread-stream condition remains: remove this rule once thread-stream no longer uses worker_threads.TransferListItem.
